svg.text: Offline semantic bank preparation · TRAIN captions only
N varies per image (max 87); empty detections → full-frame fallback.
Contextual CLIP patches; not isolated object pixels.
TRAIN: XE loss on next tokens. VALID: beam 5 → CIDEr → best checkpoint; no backward.
Frozen encoders and caches are prepared offline; learned aggregators, projector, CSA and decoder train together.
CSA adaptation • cached CLIP ROI + semantic banks • 02/11/2026
